Introduction

F.able, formerly known as ENERFIVE, is a South Korean Kpop boy group under Haeirum Entertainment, consisting of three members: Sihoon, Jeong, and Hojun. The group was originally set to debut on May 28, 2020, but the debut was postponed due to unavoidable circumstances. F.able officially debuted on June 5, 2020, with the digital single Burn It Up, featuring two new members, Junhyoung and Jaehyun, following the departure of Doha and Youngwon earlier that year.

F.able was originally a seven-member group until Doha and Youngwon both left on August 24, 2020.

It is presumed that F.able has disbanded, as three of its members, Sihoon, Junhyeong, and Jeon, were revealed to be part of a new upcoming group, Enphaze, on March 22, 2024.
